BUYING & PROJECT PLANNING

PP, PET, Acrylic and Tritan: Compare the Actual Cup Specification

Use the recorded material as a starting point, then evaluate the model, components, intended drink and documentation together.

Prepare a Project Enquiry →

Do not turn a material name into a test result

A material label does not establish the grade, temperature limit, food-contact status, impact performance or dishwasher instructions of every finished cup. Request model-specific supporting information.

Compare the complete product

The cup body, decoration, lid, straw and any light component may require different review points. Agree the actual material and components before comparing prices.

Ask for evidence that matches the order

Provide the model, material, use conditions and destination. Check whether any available record identifies the same sample and relevant scope; a generic certificate image is not enough.

Before Sending the Enquiry

Review itemWhat to send
Model & portionSKU, vessel shape and required capacity option.
Use & configurationBeverage, temperature conditions, lid, straw or other components.
Artwork & deliveryDesign quantities, decoration position, packing, destination and arrival date.

Make the Next Step Specific

Share the model, use, estimated quantity, artwork, destination and required arrival date. Identify any items you have not decided.
